name: Make stored subscriber data visible to WordPress privacy tools
query: Our newsletter plugin stores each subscriber's email, name, and IP address in a custom table when they sign up. Users keep asking us to export and delete their data under GDPR, but nothing about our subscribers shows up in Tools -> Export/Erase Personal Data — please make the plugin handle that properly.
expected_behavior: Inventory the stored PII (email, name, IP) across the plugin's tables, options, and meta

Register a personal data exporter via add_filter() on wp_privacy_personal_data_exporters, returning the subscriber's rows in the paginated export structure (group_id, group_label, item_id, data, done)
Register a personal data eraser via add_filter() on wp_privacy_personal_data_erasers
Implement the eraser to actually delete the subscriber rows with $wpdb->delete() and return the documented status array (items_removed, items_retained, messages, done)
Declare the plugin's data practices with wp_add_privacy_policy_content() hooked on admin_init via add_action()
Anonymize the IP at capture with wp_privacy_anonymize_ip() after sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( ... ) ) instead of storing the full address
Gate any display or export of subscriber PII behind current_user_can() so under-privileged users cannot read it
Define retention/cleanup so subscriber data is not kept indefinitely after the purpose expires
success_criteria: An exporter is registered on wp_privacy_personal_data_exporters and returns subscriber data in the paginated export structure
An eraser is registered on wp_privacy_personal_data_erasers, deletes the stored rows, and returns the items_removed/items_retained/messages/done status array
Privacy policy content is declared via wp_add_privacy_policy_content()
IPs are anonymized with wp_privacy_anonymize_ip() before storage; full IP addresses are no longer retained
Subscriber PII is not exposed to under-privileged users; any display or endpoint serving it is gated with current_user_can()
Retention or cleanup of stored subscriber data is defined
